content_feed.telegram_post: 📜 #ORDER_WIN | Vascon Engineers Limited (NSE: VASCONEQ) Vascon Engineers Receives ₹198 Crore Order from State Bank of India ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Client: State Bank of India - Order Value: ₹198.00 Crore (Excluding Taxes) - Scope: Construction of SBILD, residential flats and other commercial outfits at Hinjewadi, Pune - Execution Period: 24 months - Nature of Order: Domestic / EPC Mode 📌 What happened: ↳ Vascon Engineers has received a Letter of Acceptance from State Bank of India for construction work in Pune, Maharashtra, to be completed within 24 months. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
